rule: RS-15. The syllabus says its content is exhaustive except where it writes "including" (page 12). Each entry is one of its closed lists, or a body of physical geography the themes leave out, with the pattern C-11 scans learner-facing text for. The sentence is the syllabus’s; the pattern is our judgement of what teaching past the list would look like. Every contract in the subject carries every entry.

entries.construct: glacial landforms and processes (not in the syllabus)

must_catch: a glacier moving down the valley
must_allow: The Arctic has a very cold climate.

entries.syllabus_sentence: Theme 2 covers earthquakes and volcanoes, rivers, coasts, weather, and climate and natural vegetation; glaciation is not part of it.

entries.construct: coastal landforms outside the syllabus list

must_catch: a tombolo joins the island to the mainland
a salt marsh behind the spit
must_allow: A spit grows across the bay.
Coastal sand dunes form behind the beach.

entries.syllabus_sentence: Coastal landforms: cliffs, wave-cut platforms, caves, arches, stacks, stumps, bay and headland coastlines, beaches, spits and coastal sand dunes (page 12: "in Topic 2.3, all the coastal landforms you must cover are listed").

entries.construct: river landforms outside the syllabus list

must_allow: A delta forms where the river meets the sea.

entries.syllabus_sentence: Forms of river valleys: long profile and shape in cross-section, waterfalls, potholes, meanders, oxbow lakes, deltas, levées and flood plains (the list is exhaustive).

entries.construct: plate settings outside the syllabus list (hot spots)

must_catch: Hawaii lies over a hot spot
must_allow: A shield volcano is wide and gently sloping.
The plates move apart at a constructive boundary.

entries.syllabus_sentence: Plate boundaries: constructive/divergent, destructive/convergent and conservative (the list is exhaustive).

entries.construct: climates and ecosystems other than the two the syllabus names
entries.pattern: \b(savanna|tundra|taiga|temperate deciduous|temperate grassland|coniferous forest|mediterranean|monsoon|polar) (ecosystems?|biomes?)\b|\bcharacteristics of (the |a )?(mediterranean|monsoon|tundra|savanna|temperate maritime|polar) climate\b

must_catch: the characteristics of the Mediterranean climate
must_allow: The tundra is sparsely populated because it is very cold.

entries.syllabus_sentence: Two climates, equatorial and hot desert, and two ecosystems, tropical rainforest and hot desert.

entries.construct: mid-latitude weather systems (not in the syllabus)

must_allow: A tropical storm forms over warm sea.

entries.syllabus_sentence: Topic 2.4 covers the collection and use of weather data: the Stevenson screen and the instruments, cloud, calculations and graphs.
